caption: The drawing depicts a single ornate sauce boat rendered in graphite pencil on a beige or off-white background. The sauce boat is highly detailed, featuring a large, curved handle on the left with a spiral design and a wide spout on the right side. The body of the sauce boat is elliptical and slightly bulbous, with a wavy upper rim and intricate floral or monogram decoration etched on the side. The vessel stands on three feet, each resembling a stylized shell form at the top with scroll-like elements extending downward. Below the main drawing, in the lower right corner, there is a smaller inset line drawing of the same sauce boat, less detailed and primarily composed of outlines. The artist's signature, "C. Capelti," appears on the lower left side of the main rectangle framing the primary drawing. The composition is centered with the primary focus on the sauce boat, and minimal background or additional elements are included. The overall tone of the objects in the image is gray, corresponding to the pencil medium on paper.
title: Silver Sauce Boat
